name: Shuah
overview: Shuah is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Abraham through Keturah, who is described as either his wife or concubine, highlighting the continuation of Abraham's lineage beyond Isaac. The genealogies in Genesis 25:2 and 1 Chronicles 1:32 list Shuah alongside his brothers Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, and Ishbak, emphasizing his place within this family group. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 4:11 notes the relationship between Shuah and his brother Chelub, indicating the ongoing generations descending from this branch of Abraham's family.
